name: NOAA 2013 California topo-bathy merge source inventory and vertical-accuracy layers

producer.name: NOAA Office for Coastal Management; Dewberry California Coastal Data Merge Project

units.reported_vertical_accuracy: RMSEz where available; acoustic BAG values generalized; not a conservative upper bound

spatial.horizontal_crs: NAD83 NSRS2007 UTM zones 10/11 in the project report; deliverables not inspected
spatial.vertical_datum: NAVD88 Geoid09 in the project report; per-cell provenance not inspected

temporal.update_cadence: Historical 2013 project; monthly discovery and original-file integrity check

provenance.access_service: Official NOAA processing report and USGS Offshore Monterey bathymetry XML
transformations: Hash-pinned official NOAA 2013 project report and USGS 2016 Offshore Monterey bathymetry metadata.
Extracted NOAA's documented deliverable types and missing-data semantics; no original accuracy or source-inventory values have been acquired or attached to research cells.

evidence.supports: NOAA's 2013 report lists Full_DataInventory.xlsx, acoustic-source extent FGDB, vertical-accuracy raster/vector, void mask and seamlines; acoustic accuracy varies or is unavailable, with undefined raster values -9999.
USGS states its 2 m Monterey bathymetry was downloaded from the 2013 NOAA merge and resampled, rather than independently surveyed as a new 2016 grid.

limitations: The project report documents accuracy and source-inventory deliverables, but their original per-cell values and exact download locations were not found in the checked public supplemental listing.
The 2013 NOAA merge may reuse the 1995 or 1998 sources; close agreement with the 2016 USGS resample is not independent validation.
Source-reported RMSE or generalized BAG uncertainty, where present, is not automatically a conservative all-cell upper bound after datum transformation, gridding and position uncertainty.
No original accuracy-layer values have been intersected with the 17 Monterey research outlines; this candidate cannot qualify a 300 ft MLLW target.
